visualDirection: Technical blueprint; deliberately low fidelity; monochrome neutral canvas; one blue annotation accent; compact grotesk and monospace; 1px structure lines.

families.tabletNotes: At 768px the hero becomes a single reading column; the product-definition rule follows the primary actions, and the evidence proof remains value-before-source.

annotations.title: Shell boundary
annotations.detail: Public marketing header only; do not mount the workspace navigation.

annotations.title: Specific promise
annotations.detail: Lead with sparse input to evidence-backed output, not generic AI automation.

annotations.title: Proof specimen
annotations.detail: Use BA-100-025, body_material, Bronze C84400, score 0.728, and policy gate 0.707.

annotations.title: Primary handoff
annotations.detail: Enter operations is primary; Enrich a record is the direct secondary workflow.

families.tabletNotes: At 768px the message and actions stack while the public header remains; no workspace rail appears.

annotations.title: Global boundary
annotations.detail: This 404 belongs to the public marketing surface.

annotations.title: Exact message
annotations.detail: This record path does not exist.

annotations.title: Two recoveries
annotations.detail: Return to AXIOM overview or enter Operations.

families.tabletNotes: At 768px the persistent desktop rail is replaced by the app bar plus horizontally scrollable workflow navigation. Preserve the data-source banner above main content and keep the active route in view.

annotations.title: Canonical order
annotations.detail: Operations, Enrich, Resolve, Process, Publish, Audit; Intelligence is secondary.

annotations.title: Collapsible rail
annotations.detail: Expanded rail shows descriptors; collapsed rail retains glyphs, tooltips, labels, and active state.

annotations.title: Truth banner
annotations.detail: Offline fixture is persistent and cannot be mistaken for live persisted data.

annotations.title: Boundaries stay inside shell
annotations.detail: Loading, error, and workspace 404 preserve navigation and recovery context.

families.tabletNotes: At 768px use a two-by-two stat band and retain the risk-ordered blocking list as rows; recent activity moves below the intervention list.

annotations.title: Operational headline
annotations.detail: Blocked catalogues say Catalog work that needs intervention; clear catalogues say Portfolio is clear to progress.

annotations.title: Portfolio denominator
annotations.detail: Required-gap counts explicitly exclude unclassified records.

annotations.title: Risk order
annotations.detail: The preview exposes only the highest-risk blocked records and hands off to Resolve.

annotations.title: Recorded, not live execution
annotations.detail: Recent activity links to persisted Process and Audit context.

families.tabletNotes: At 768px the run-control rail drops below identity and source fields. Cost and real-model-call disclosure must remain before the submit control.

annotations.title: Only live run
annotations.detail: This is the only console workflow that starts model work and incurs cost.

annotations.title: Input gate
annotations.detail: MPN and manufacturer are required; with retrieval off, description or HTTPS source URL is also required.

annotations.title: Cost before action
annotations.detail: Show two calls per run, three with generated copy, and one concurrent run.

annotations.title: Refusals are remedies
annotations.detail: Refused, unavailable, and conflict states stay distinct; conflict alone offers deliberate replacement.

families.tabletNotes: At 768px summary figures become a two-column band. Search and filters wrap above full-width SKU groups; paging remains after the queue and never inside a clipped table.

annotations.title: Decision work
annotations.detail: Separate below-threshold values, required gaps, no-class records, and ambiguous classification.

annotations.title: Risk-ranked groups
annotations.detail: Each SKU exposes open counts and the actual values or gaps before navigation.

annotations.title: Filter truth
annotations.detail: No match differs from no SKUs: one clears filters, the other explains how to create recorded output.

annotations.title: Accepted remains legible
annotations.detail: Fully accepted records are a state, not silently removed from every view.

families.tabletNotes: At 768px retain a single-column reading order: record summary, attribute queue, selected value, evidence, validation, sources, variants, cross-source, equivalence. Do not create a persistent three-pane layout.

annotations.title: Keyboard queue
annotations.detail: Queue focus owns J/K movement and A/X/E decisions; ordinary page input never intercepts those keys.

annotations.title: Confidence is structural
annotations.detail: Calibrated score, policy threshold, reason, provenance method, and status form the decision header.

annotations.title: Evidence is the demo
annotations.detail: Exact source span is highlighted over a stable PDF page; zoom changes coordinates, not page identity.

annotations.title: Immediate persistence
annotations.detail: Saving, success with prior movement, error, and offline-disabled states are explicit.

annotations.title: Context below decision
annotations.detail: Validation, source inventory, variants, cross-source findings, and equivalence remain reachable without obscuring evidence.

families.tabletNotes: At 768px the selector stays above a two-column stage grid. Below that, stages become one column in pipeline order with no horizontal timeline dependency.

annotations.title: Replay-only boundary
annotations.detail: No upload and no Run control; every stage is reconstructed from persisted output.

annotations.title: Nine-stage order
annotations.detail: Ingest, Parse, Resolve, Classify, Extract, Normalize, Validate, Decide, Activate.

annotations.title: Model confinement
annotations.detail: Each stage identifies whether the recorded run used a model or deterministic code.

annotations.title: Reduced motion
annotations.detail: Replay progress becomes an immediate static complete state without travel or stagger.

families.tabletNotes: At 768px the item-master and optional-document steps precede output settings. The 252-column preview remains a labelled horizontal-scroll region rather than compressed cells.

annotations.title: Contract is live
annotations.detail: Format, column count, join key, file limits, and accepted outputs come from the export service.

annotations.title: Staging gate
annotations.detail: Export stays locked until an item master is staged; optional documents explain why sparse output can be correct.

annotations.title: Result taxonomy
annotations.detail: Rejected input, interrupted export, downloaded file, and JSON preview have different next actions.

annotations.title: Sparse is not failed
annotations.detail: Populated, blank, and withheld columns and empty subsections are reported separately.

families.tabletNotes: At 768px preserve the horizontally scrollable audit table with a named region. Signature status and SKU remain the first scan columns; pagination follows the complete list.

annotations.title: Corpus-level claim
annotations.detail: All signatures valid is computed across the whole catalogue, not only the current page.

annotations.title: Signed facts only
annotations.detail: Queued candidates are counted but never presented as certified values.

annotations.title: Empty means no artifact
annotations.detail: Do not render a table header or invented generation date when no run exists.

families.tabletNotes: At 768px quality and contents stack, then signature, certified values, gaps, channel readiness, sources, and generated copy. Long hashes wrap in monospace without truncating the verification claim.

annotations.title: Signature first
annotations.detail: Valid or invalid recomputed content hash is visible before the certified value table.

annotations.title: Measured quality
annotations.detail: Unmeasured richness has no zero-width bar and is excluded from the renormalized composite.

annotations.title: Certified set
annotations.detail: Every value pairs method, exact citation locator, and evidence status; an empty certified set is explained.

annotations.title: Downstream readiness
annotations.detail: Gaps, channels, and generated-copy variants remain separate audit sections.

families.tabletNotes: At 768px impact arms, policy figures, and cost tiers each become stacked sections. The policy control retains a full-width curve plot or an explicit no-curve explanation.

annotations.title: Three claims, three sections
annotations.detail: Cohort impact, acceptance policy, and unit economics never collapse into one blended score.

annotations.title: Trust context
annotations.detail: Treatment/control trust variants identify measured, drifting, or absent comparisons.

annotations.title: Policy is a what-if
annotations.detail: Pending, error, achievable, unachievable, and no-curve are explicit and do not silently reclassify values.

annotations.title: Missing cost is unknown
annotations.detail: Absent and partial pricing stay unavailable rather than becoming zero dollars.

families.tabletNotes: At 768px the current fixed 280px + two minmax panes already become compressed. This is documented as a limitation; no responsive redesign is implied.

annotations.title: Historical surface
annotations.detail: This root route belongs to FastAPI, not the Next.js public landing.

annotations.title: Fixed three panes
annotations.detail: Queue, value, and evidence are always grid columns with global overflow hidden.

annotations.title: Narrow-screen limitation
annotations.detail: At 390px the 280px queue consumes most of the viewport while value/evidence compress and clip; header controls also overflow.

annotations.title: Legacy behavior
annotations.detail: Session selection, error-budget policy, keyboard decisions, and line evidence remain represented as current behavior.

families.tabletNotes: At 768px the existing two-column form becomes its one-column layout; the 252-column result preview remains horizontally scrollable with a sticky header.

annotations.title: Linear legacy task
annotations.detail: Supplier item master in, delivery file out; distinct from the three-pane legacy Review.

annotations.title: Contract readout
annotations.detail: The page loads the live delivery format before describing the output.

annotations.title: File and output errors
annotations.detail: Unreadable files, wrong columns, empty row selection, and output failures require distinct messages.

annotations.title: Success split
annotations.detail: Downloaded XLSX/CSV and JSON preview are separate successful outcomes.
